title: A Counter Sale part sale can bill any other customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the organization's Counter Sale customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for the Counter Sale customer, open, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for the Counter Sale customer.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • Customer B is offered.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
